title: Teach the record-triggered flow null-guard gate in the formula skill and the flows page
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbaBjisxkQo9hht9bFB

Filing gate: the `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` line of PR #29474 (for #29026, `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`). Filed by the `domain:devx` seat that lands #29474. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

## What changes when PR #29474 lands

The publish-time null-guard gate (`os validate` / `os build` / the runtime publish gate, `@objectstack/lint`) also judges flows whose trigger is `record_change`: the start node's `config.condition`, every edge `condition` (container regions included) and every `decision` branch `expression`. An ordering (`< <= > >=`) or arithmetic operator on a declared nullable field of the trigger object, with no dominating `!= null` / `== null` / `!isBlank()`, is refused, because the run sees every declared field (null when empty) and the CEL fault fails the run while the record write still lands. A bare `budget` is judged as `record.budget` only where the flow's bound names are provable. A guard in the start condition counts at every edge and branch. `count` / `sum` roll-up summaries are always valued (zero children reads 0); `min` / `max` / `avg` stay nullable.

## Where the teaching is now stale (on `main` `8ca9dd7b`)

1. `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md` :112–119: "This is a publish-time rejection" names only validation-rule and hook predicates. It needs the record-triggered flow slots, the bare-name rule, the start-condition guard and the roll-up nuance. The skill's evals should exercise one refused flow edge. This path is governed (Tier H).
2. `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx`: the condition examples (:33–59, e.g. `order_amount > 10000` on an edge) say nothing about nullable fields on a record-triggered flow. Add the rule and the `!= null` remedy where edge and decision conditions are taught.

## Done when

Both teach what PR #29474's code does, read off `packages/lint/src/validate-null-guards.ts` (its ledger) and `validate-expressions.ts` (`checkFlowNullGuards`) as merged, not restated from this card. Do not start before PR #29474 merges.

Blocked-by: #29026
Dedupe: searched `"null guard" flow skill`: #29026, #28951, and #29094 (open, same skill file, a different paragraph: the sparse action-binding rule; serial on `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md`). **New.**
